ruleDefinitions.name: Security Support Provider (SSP) Added to LSA Configuration
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the addition of a SSP to the registry. Upon a reboot or API call, SSP DLLs gain access to encrypted and plaintext passwords stored in Windows.

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX("\\\\Control\\\\Lsa\\\\Security\\ Packages$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\Control\\\\Lsa\\\\OSConfig\\\\Security\\ Packages$")) AND  NOT ((process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\system32\\msiexec\.exe" OR process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\syswow64\\MsiExec\.exe"))
